declarations.docstring: For a multi-index of the prescribed total degree, the weighted coefficient sum over the auxiliary polynomials equals a product of binomial coefficients.
A coefficient of the auxiliary permutation polynomial expands as a finite sum of auxiliary coefficients times partition-polynomial coefficients.
Evaluation at one of the auxiliary permutation polynomial is the sum of its coefficients over the finitely supported antidiagonal.
Evaluation at one of the auxiliary permutation polynomial expands as a weighted sum of evaluations of the partition polynomials.
The product of two finite sums transformed by the auxiliary kernel sums to the factorial-scaled pointwise product sum.
For a multi-index of fixed total degree, the sum of the displayed finite fiber cardinalities is a product of binomial coefficients.
